punchline: Ferriss tests whether anyone wants a product before he makes any of it.
thirty_sec: Most founders write a plan, raise money, build the product, and only then find out if anyone wants it. Tim Ferriss describes the opposite for his supplement business, BrainQUICKEN. He puts up a basic page, runs small search ads to it, and counts how many people click and how many try to order. If the numbers are good, he makes the product. If not, he drops it and has lost very little.
